question: Mimic 3 more episodes and visualize my dataset.
ground_truth: This prompt runs uv run --project tools/mimic i4h-mimic on the latest HDF5 recording with --episodes 3 --include-source --successful-only into a new runs/<workflow>/<timestamp>/ directory, then converts the expanded HDF5 to LeRobot and serves it with the LeRobot visualizer.
expected_behavior: uses the latest HDF5 recording as input
adds three action-jitter variants with --episodes 3, keeping the sources with --include-source
inspects the expanded HDF5 and reports source, generated, and total counts
continues to i4h-workflow-dataset-convert and i4h-lerobot-viz for visualization
reports the augmented dataset and visualizer URL

question: Expand my scissor pick-and-place recording to 10 episodes with small action and state noise.
ground_truth: This prompt runs i4h-mimic on a scissor_pick_and_place recording with small action noise (for example --noise 0.01) and --episodes set to 10 minus the successful sources kept by --include-source, and states that the tool adds no independent state noise.
expected_behavior: uses an existing scissor_pick_and_place HDF5 recording as input
treats --episodes as additional variants and sizes it so the final total is 10
does not claim to add independent state noise, rerun physics, or synthesize new camera frames
